# BEGIN wordpress-first  (doi 2026-09-20)
# WordPress phuc vu site. 748 file index.html tinh van con trong thu muc nhung KHONG duoc dung
# nua vi index.php dung truoc. Muon quay lai site tinh: dao lai thanh
#   DirectoryIndex index.html index.php
# va xoa khoi "# BEGIN WordPress" ben duoi. Ban htaccess cu: docs/server/htaccess-live-2026-09-20b.txt
DirectoryIndex index.php index.html
# END wordpress-first

# BEGIN duhoctesolhcmc.vn canonical host  (them 2026-09-18)
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
RewriteEngine On

# 1. KHONG dung vao xac thuc SSL - neu chan, AutoSSL se khong gia han duoc cert
RewriteRule ^\.well-known/ - [L]

# 1b. 4 trang nganh rong tu WP export (soft-404) -> trang nganh that  (them 2026-09-20)
RewriteRule ^nganh-hoc/cntt/?$ https://duhoctesolhcmc.vn/nganh-hoc/cong-nghe/ [R=301,L]
RewriteRule ^nganh-hoc/ky-thuat/?$ https://duhoctesolhcmc.vn/nganh-hoc/cong-nghe/ [R=301,L]
RewriteRule ^nganh-hoc/kinh-doanh/?$ https://duhoctesolhcmc.vn/nganh-hoc/kinh-te/ [R=301,L]
RewriteRule ^nganh-hoc/y-suc-khoe/?$ https://duhoctesolhcmc.vn/nganh-hoc/suc-khoe/ [R=301,L]

# 1c. URL cua ban tinh KHONG con ton tai trong WordPress -> trang tuong duong  (them 2026-09-20)
# 5 URL nay la trang luu tru phan loai rong, theme co y loai khoi sitemap (xem inc/seo.php:
# "Taxonomy archive khong index - trang mong trung /tin-tuc/"). Chung nam trong sitemap.xml da
# nop cho Google ngay 19/09 nen chuyen huong thay vi de 404.
RewriteRule ^bac-hoc/(cao-dang|dai-hoc)/?$ https://duhoctesolhcmc.vn/truong/ [R=301,L]
RewriteRule ^gia-tri-hoc-bong/(25|50|toan-phan)/?$ https://duhoctesolhcmc.vn/hoc-bong/ [R=301,L]

# 1d. sitemap.xml tinh da xoa; WordPress tu sinh /wp-sitemap.xml (luon cap nhat theo noi dung).
# Giu redirect de muc sitemap da khai bao trong Search Console khong bi loi.
RewriteRule ^sitemap\.xml$ https://duhoctesolhcmc.vn/wp-sitemap.xml [R=301,L]

# 1e. 748 file index.html cua site tinh van nam trong docroot, va rule "!-f" o cuoi cho phep
# goi thang /duong-dan/index.html -> Apache tra ve file HTML cu, bo qua WordPress. Nghia la
# moi trang deu ton tai hai ban, va 14 trang du lieu mau da go ngay 21/09 van doc duoc tai
# /hoc-bong/principal-50/index.html. Chuyen ve URL sach de WordPress phuc vu.
# Ban tinh deu da co canonical tro ve URL sach nen 301 nay dung huong Google da biet.
# (them 2026-09-21)
RewriteRule ^(.*/)?index\.html$ https://duhoctesolhcmc.vn/$1 [R=301,L]

# 2. Subdomain test cu -> domain chinh
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^duhoctesol\.duystudy\.vn$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://duhoctesolhcmc.vn/$1 [R=301,L]

# 3. Subdomain cPanel tu sinh khi tao addon domain -> domain chinh
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^duhoctesolhcmc\.vn\.amigoagency\.vn$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://duhoctesolhcmc.vn/$1 [R=301,L]

# 4. www -> non-www  (canonical trong trang la non-www)
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^www\.duhoctesolhcmc\.vn$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://duhoctesolhcmc.vn/$1 [R=301,L]

# 5. http -> https cho domain chinh
RewriteCond %{HTTPS} !=on
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^duhoctesolhcmc\.vn$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://duhoctesolhcmc.vn/$1 [R=301,L]
</IfModule>
# END duhoctesolhcmc.vn canonical host

# BEGIN WordPress
# Rewrite cho permalink dep (/%postname%/). Dat SAU khoi canonical host de 301 o tren chay truoc.
#
# KHAC voi rule mac dinh cua WordPress: ban mac dinh co dieu kien  !-d  (bo qua thu muc co that).
# Docroot nay van con 748 thu muc cua site tinh cu (vd /truong/adrian-high-school/ chua index.html),
# nen voi  !-d  thi mod_rewrite bo qua -> DirectoryIndex lai lay index.html -> WordPress KHONG chay.
# Da do dung thuc te: 746/751 URL van tra ve file tinh. Vi vay BO  !-d  va loai tru thu muc he thong.
# Khi nao xoa het 748 file index.html cu thi co the quay ve rule mac dinh.
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
RewriteEngine On
RewriteBase /
RewriteRule ^index\.php$ - [L]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/(wp-admin|wp-includes|wp-content|cgi-bin)/ [NC]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
RewriteRule . /index.php [L]
</IfModule>
# END WordPress
